svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Core: Java, Spring Boot, JPA / Hibernate, Maven, Spring Security, REST APIs; Security: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT / JWKS, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, RBAC, Multi-tenancy; Data: PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Flyway; Messaging & Infra: Kafka, Docker, Git, Spring Cloud Gateway, Eureka, Zipkin; Testing & Docs: JUnit 5, OpenAPI, Mockito, Testcontainers, WireMock
